Only, Phainon didn’t take that hand that was offered to him - instead slowly blinking at Mydei several times, looking as if he had seen a ghost all before he straightened his head out a little. Merely to look at that hand with wide eyes, and right back to Mydei’s face questioningly. 

“The..” Phainon started, trailing off immediately as if he was truly debating his next words before finally managing to barely utter them, “The son of Kremnoan Co.?”

“Mhm.”

“Oh my god. Why didn’t I connect the names..?” Phainon immediately mumbled out, putting a head to his head and ruffling up his own hair with his own thoughts - brows knitting together as his eyes wandered to nothing in particular, “And the death of your mother!? Oh my god it was all over the news too this week..”

“It’s fine, really. I preferred it this way.” Mydei reassured him with a small laugh leaving his throat.

Only, Phainon gave him a look - one that read as beyond merely horrified as he came to some sort of realization in his pretty little head that Mydei wasn’t privy to yet.

“You.. Mean I.. Gave a famous CEO a handjob under the table and then tied him up and-”

“Yeah.” Mydei cut in, not truly wanting to listen to Phainon rehash all the insane things he had done to Mydei’s body and mind today. Actually living through it was enough for Mydei to try to adapt to as it was - to hear that man talk about fucking him again..

.. Mydei didn’t think his legs would live through another session if he got hard once more.

“I’m getting fired..” Phainon whimpered out after a few seconds, making Mydei roll his eyes over how dramatic his new boyfriend was. 

All before pressing on that door to open it up - desiring to leave the room he had been locked in for a hot minute now finally. Especially now that he wasn’t dreading the idea of Phainon immediately trying to get away from him.

Quite the opposite, really, considering the way when he opened that door Phainon instantaneously glued himself to his side - not hesitating at all to occupy the space beside Mydei happily. 

“Why? I asked how to invest. I clearly enjoyed myself. So long as you don’t do that to anyone else, I’ll invest.” Mydei told him with a huff as he tried to steady himself - every foot fall felt like needles up the back of his legs however. 

Needles that pricked all the way up to his spine and left an ebbing pain there - not to mention the way he was almost positive he was still leaking from his ass onto his clothes.

Embarrassing, but having Phainon pressed up against him was a little bit comforting, he had to admit that much.

“You.. You’re investing if.. I promise myself to you and only you?”

Mydei felt himself purse his lips up just a bit as he tried to look at that man sternly, looking at the way Phainon looked as happy as could be. 

.. Mydei couldn’t really blame him, if his ass didn’t hurt, he probably would be in the same sort of mood. 

Mydei had to chuckle over that regardless, flitting his eyes forward once more, “Not quite what I said but I like the enthusiasm.” 

“But I have to keep my hands to myself and only you, right?” Phainon inquired immediately not waiting a single moment for Mydei to even prepare himself.

And well.. Mydei could only huff a laugh over that. 

“I guess.”

But that didn’t appear to be enough for Phainon - instead that man gave a sharp little whistle as he matched Mydei’s rather achingly slow walking pace, leaning a little to make sure Mydei was looking him in the eyes, “So we’re dating,  right?”

And Mydei certainly did stare him in the eyes - even if he felt his eye twitch over how he almost felt like that man was mocking him.

.. He really should not be taller than Mydei, it felt a little demented for someone to be taller than him when he was already giant. But whatever. 

“.. I guess?” Mydei slowly agreed, his mind already confusedly reeling over the way that truly did mean.. They were dating?

Boyfriends..?

Mydei didn’t know anything about this man really, and yet..? 

.. Why was he fighting the urge to match that beautiful smile creeping on Phainon’s features widely?

“Wow.. I had such a good day today. Can we kiss?” Phainon asked, and that tone was much too nervous for a man who had just given Mydei joint pain for the next week. 

“You have been inside of me in more ways than one.. Yes, we can kiss.”

Mydei barely finished his thoughts before a hand was on his chin and tilting his head just a little to the side (and a little up but Mydei refused to acknowledge that). All before lips were on his own - soft, tender, slightly wet and that kiss..

Was much too chaste, too sweet and gentle for the way Phainon had tied up Mydei until his wrists were raw, red and bruised.. Yet, for some reason, that felt like that was all their first kiss needed to be. A sweet shared thing between them both. Just the start of whatever their long road of love would lead them to with many deeper kisses.

And Phainon pulled away quickly - beaming a happy smile at Mydei that was much too akin to a gleeful little puppy to Mydei’s mind. 

“I got a boyfriend at work today, I feel so alive! But uh.. Are you alright? You’re walking oddly.” Phainon asked - instantly earning a heavy glare from Mydei over those words.

Because whose fault was that? Mydei had to think it was that snow white haired mutt’s fault - glaring deeply over the question. If he wasn’t so endearing to Mydei, Mydei was pretty sure he would have been trying to kill this man, not letting him have sex with him upon meeting. 

“.. My legs feel numb.”

Phainon, for some weird reason, only seemed to perk up at that - moving immediately to the front of Mydei and halting their slow and tedious walk; “Oh! Should I carry you?” 

“What?” Mydei asked on instinct, but it didn’t really matter as Phainon was already borderline body slamming him - all while hooking his arms under Mydei’s legs, “Phainon, Wait.”

But it didn’t seem like Phainon knew the meaning of ‘wait’ ever in his life. Instead only swiftly moving to knock Mydei off his feet and into his arms instead. 

“Wow! You’re a lot lighter than I expected.” Phainon chirped out almost instantly as he moved to angle Mydei against his chest more - pressing the both of them close and Mydei found his arms wrapping around the man’s neck to hold on as well.

He could feel the way his cheeks were already heating up from this position, just to huff over it loudly, “.. Don’t say that.”

“Let’s exit through the back, okay?” Phainon offered without even waiting a moment more for more refusals from Mydei, instead only seeming to hug him closer as he gave a little chuckle, “You’re blushing. Do you like being carried like this?”

Mydei moved his gaze away from him at that - trying his best to instead focus on the stretching hallway in front of the both of them. 

“It’s embarrassing.” Mydei mumbled out quietly, trying to quell the burn in his cheeks even though it felt impossible as he remained being princess carried by Phainon. Even worse as Phainon angled himself enough to rub their heads together with a bubbly laugh as he continued walking.

“My beautiful boyfriend should get used to it, and uh..”

“Hmm?”

Phainon made an odd little noise - clearing his throat of some kind that drew Mydei’s eyes back to him, staring at the way Phainon seemed just a little distracted as his blue eyes flickered from focusing on walking, and the man in his arms; “Sorry.. About the loss of your mother..”

“Ah.”

Phainon pursed his lips over that - eyes blinking at the man he was princess carrying through the empty back halls, all before he asked a question that made Mydei huff a laugh out; “.. Was that a mood killer?”

Mydei couldn’t help but find that man charming, regardless of the ‘mood killer’ he had just committed. 

“Extremely.”

“My bad.”
